title: Ammonium Vanadium
text: This remedy is characterized by its action on the metabolic processes and the respiratory organs. It is useful in cases of chronic wasting diseases and chronic respiratory disorders. There is a general feeling of weakness and debility. It is also useful in cases of anemia and malnutrition. Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead. Vertigo. Appetite poor. Nausea. Heaviness and pressure after eating. Shortness of breath on motion. Violent cough, with a sensation of oppression in the chest. Aching and lameness in the limbs. Heaviness in the legs. Compare: Vanadium; Phosphorus; Arsenicum album. Third to sixth potency.
